content: अपस् {%n.%} [आप् असुन् ह्रस्वश्च; आपः कर्माख्यायां ह्रस्वो नुट् च वा स्यात् <ls>Uṇ. 4. 207</ls>. अप्नः, अपः] .²1 Work, action; अपसा सन्तु नेमे <ls>Rv. 1. 54. 8</ls>. .²2 Sacred act or rite, sacrificial work. .²3 Water. --{%a.%} (अपाः) .²1 Active, engaged in any act (कर्मयुक्त). .²2 Got or obtained. According to <ls>B. and R.</ls> अपसः {%f.%} <ab>pl.</ab> stands in the Veda for (1) the hands and fingers busy in kindling the sacred fire and performing the sacrificial rites; (2) the three goddesses of sacred speech or the three divinties, fire, wind and sun; and (3) the active or running waters. [<ab>cf.</ab> <lang>L.</lang> {%opus%}.]
